about: Port Colborne is a city at the Lake Erie end of the Welland Canal in Niagara Region, Ontario. A working canal harbour, lakeside beaches, and a downtown along the water define a smaller Niagara centre south of Welland. It combines marine industry heritage with summer shore tourism. About 20,000 people live in Port Colborne.
seoSummary: Niagara city at the Lake Erie mouth of the Welland Canal—harbour, beaches, and canal watching.
